title: Shooter kills three children and one teacher at Oregon elementary school
summary_full: Two people critical in hospital as officials in Bend say 16-year-old suspect shot dead by bystanderOregon elementary school shooting: what we know so farSchools in Bend, Oregon, will be closed on Friday after a 16-year-old shooter opened fire at an elementary school in the city on Thursday, killing three children and a teacher before he was shot dead by a community member.The children killed at Silver Rail elementary school were aged five, eight and 11, officials said.
